description: List the model catalog (video, image, audio, upscale, llm) with the short aliases you can pass as 'model'. Filter by category and/or provider (e.g. provider: 'google'). Use the returned ids or aliases on the generation tools, or category 'llm' ids on the chat tool. Refreshed hourly from the live catalog.

category.description: Filter by category ('llm' is the chat/text models for the chat tool). Omit to return everything.

provider.description: Filter by provider. Takes the stable key ('google', 'black-forest-labs', 'moonshotai') or the human name the user is likely to say ('Black Forest Labs', 'Moonshot AI'). Case-insensitive. Combinable with category.

refresh.description: Set true to bypass the hourly cache and re-fetch the live catalog now.

name: list_models
title: List models
